beats.name: problem and comedic turn
beats.line: Still opening twenty career tabs and rewriting the same application? Here is a five-step workflow to prepare your shortlist with Claude, while you keep control of every submission.
beats.visual: Hammad full at warm desk; open tabs become an original Remotion five-step progress rail.
beats.caption_text: Still opening twenty career tabs and rewriting the same application? Here is a five-step workflow to prepare your shortlist with Claude, while you keep control of every submission.

beats.name: 1 connect
beats.line: First, connect Microsoft’s Playwright browser tool to Claude. The tool is open source; Claude access and usage are separate.
beats.visual: Hammad lower half; official Playwright config close-up and actual connected tools.
beats.caption_text: First, connect Microsoft’s Playwright browser tool to Claude. The tool is open source; Claude access and usage are separate.

beats.name: 2 resume and preferences
beats.line: Second, add your resume and specify the role, location and date range.
beats.visual: Hammad lower half; real chat/resume/preferences entry.
beats.caption_text: Second, add your resume and specify the role, location and date range.

beats.name: 3 research
beats.line: Third, search company career pages for recent openings, and keep the source links. If a posting date is missing, flag it.
beats.visual: Hammad lower half; real read-only company listing and visible date/source.
beats.caption_text: Third, search company career pages for recent openings, and keep the source links. If a posting date is missing, flag it.

beats.name: 4 shortlist
beats.line: Fourth, compare each role with your actual experience, then put up to ten strong matches in a sheet, with evidence and gaps.
beats.visual: Hammad lower half; actual sheet/CSV with evidence and gaps.
beats.caption_text: Fourth, compare each role with your actual experience, then put up to ten strong matches in a sheet, with evidence and gaps.

beats.name: 5 form drafts
beats.line: Fifth, draft the application fields and a company-specific answer using only facts you can support.
beats.visual: Hammad lower half; labeled sample form and draft answer.
beats.caption_text: Fifth, draft the application fields and a company-specific answer using only facts you can support.

beats.name: scope caveat
beats.line: Where a site permits automation, it can help fill the form, but it will not work everywhere.
beats.visual: Brief Hammad punch-in; cards: site permission / compatibility.
beats.caption_text: Where a site permits automation, it can help fill the form, but it will not work everywhere.

beats.name: review and human submit
beats.line: Stop before Submit. Check the resume, dates, eligibility and every answer yourself.
beats.visual: Sample form close-up; Hammad remains in bottom corner, review pointers, Submit untouched.
beats.caption_text: Stop before Submit. Check the resume, dates, eligibility and every answer yourself.

beats.name: CTA
beats.line: Comment JOBKIT for the setup, prompt and review checklist!
beats.visual: Hammad desk close; simple warm end card JOBKIT, prompt + checklist, withhammad.com.
beats.caption_text: Comment JOBKIT for the setup, prompt and review checklist!

keyword_reason: Specific uppercase resource keyword; avoids generic AUTO collisions with earlier automations.
cover_spec: Warm desk/library setting, Hammad lower-left or centered, original abstract assistant card right; cream outlined serif hook near desk. Crop closer than source to keep face recognizable. Copy: Prepare your NEXT application. Kicker: Claude + Playwright.

assets.what: User-owned demo form and fictional resume

caption_style_to_match: Cream/amber bold serif clauses, dark stroke, 1–2 lines at popup seam, timed to voice. No whole-screen source captions reused.
reference_flaws_and_fixes: Tiny wide UI → narrow capture and one relevant control at a time, minimum 32px UI text in final.
No provenance in animated listings → real source URLs/dates, or clearly marked illustrative sample.
Invented match scores → evidence and gaps.
Brand-like orange robot and student likeness → Hammad and an original abstract assistant panel.
Unclear third-party UI montage → original recording of actual supported client; no fabricated connected status.
Long almost-static form section → sequential highlights tied to voice, keeping steps intact.
Claim-heavy comedy → original practical hook; source claims corrected.
Low visual hierarchy in opening architecture → closer presenter crop and legible five-step rail.
Blank/black transition around 66s → short continuous color fade, no black gap.
deviation_reason: Source is a fictional animated dialogue; latest user requested Hammad HeyGen avatar + Remotion backgrounds. Preserve workflow and visual roles, change speaker/characters and original wording.
latest_owner_override: English only. No large face avatar. Small 330x587 presenter PIP bottom-right. Existing generated avatar rejected; replacement must be approved before final output.
production_realization: Original illustrated five-step cards, clearly labeled illustrative; actual Microsoft documentation screen recording. No pretend live job results.
